profile.ja: 古代遺跡の発掘・研究をライフワークとする魔女。一国を支配できるほどの強大な力を持ちながらも表舞台に出る野心はなく、ひたすら古代遺跡の研究を行っている。遺跡には数か月滞在することもあり、食料から道具まで全て遺跡内にあるものや生息する動植物を材料にして自活している。研究は自身の知的好奇心を満たすためのもので、功名心はまったくなく、大発見をしても淡々と自分の手帳に書きこんでいくだけ。見つけた古代の魔導具や宝物も、このまま朽ちていくよりはと遠慮なく貰って自分のモノにしていく。一方で、遺跡に別の研究者などが現れると積極的に手伝ったり助けたりし、食事の世話まで焼くこともある。いつも遺跡に滞在し、その穏やかで気長、世間ずれしていない性格もあって彼女を目撃した研究者からは遺跡に住まう妖精か何かのように思われ逆に研究されたりもしていた。呪いの魔導具の力で歳を取らない代わりに、いつ突然死するか分からない呪いをかけられているが、その時がきたらその時だと達観している。ある時、彼女は研究の成果を書き溜めてあった書物を何者かに盗み出されてしまい、その行方を追うために人間界へと向かった。
profile.en: She is a witch who has dedicated her life to the excavation and research of ancient ruins. Despite possessing immense power that could control a nation, she has no ambition to take the stage, and instead focuses solely on her research. She often stays in the ruins for months, living off the land and using the materials and wildlife available to her. Her research is driven by her intellectual curiosity, and she has no desire for fame or recognition. Even when she makes significant discoveries, she simply records them in her notebook without fanfare. She also has no qualms about taking ancient magical artifacts or treasures for herself, reasoning that it's better than letting them decay. On the other hand, when other researchers visit the ruins, she actively helps and assists them, even going so far as to cook for them. Due to her calm and gentle nature, as well as her lack of worldly experience from spending so much time in the ruins, she is often seen as a mystical being, and has even been studied by other researchers. She is also under a curse from a magical artifact that prevents her from aging, but also makes her susceptible to sudden death at any moment. When her research notes were stolen, she set out to track down the thief and recover her work.

text.ja: 私は魔女のローシィ・モチモイだよ。遺跡発掘ばかりしてたから世間には疎いんだけど、よろしく頼むねぇ
text.en: I'm Lowsy Mochimoi, the witch. I've been so focused on excavating ruins that I'm a bit out of touch with the world, but nice to meet you.

text.ja: 呪いの魔導具の効果で見かけは若いけれども、中身はおばあちゃんだからねぇ。大事にしてくれると嬉しいねぇ
text.en: The curse of the magical artifact keeps me looking young, but inside, I'm just an old lady. It's nice to have someone to take care of me.

text.ja: オレオレ詐欺……？　はて、カフェオレの仲間とかかい？　ごめんねぇ、新しいものには疎いんだよぉ
text.en: Ore-ore scam? What's that, some kind of coffee drink? Sorry, I'm not familiar with new things.

text.ja: 遺跡には何年もこもって調査するから、外へ出たのはそうさねぇ……もう忘れちゃったよ
text.en: I've spent so much time in the ruins that I've lost track of how long it's been since I last went outside... I've even forgotten what it's like.

text.ja: 遺跡の調査はどれだけ続けても飽きないよぉ。私の生き甲斐みたいなもんだねぇ
text.en: I never get tired of researching the ruins. It's my passion, my reason for living.

text.ja: 研究結果の発表？　今まで考えたこともなかったねぇ。これは私の趣味だから、大っぴらにする気なんてないよ
text.en: Presenting my research findings? I've never thought about that before. This is just a hobby for me, so I don't plan on sharing it with the world.

text.ja: 私が遺跡に住む妖精……？　あはは、それは何かの間違いだよぉ
text.en: People think I'm a mystical being living in the ruins? Ha ha, that's just a misunderstanding.

text.ja: お前さんも遺跡の発掘がしたいって？　それじゃあ、ついでだから私も手伝うよ
text.en: You want to excavate the ruins too? Well, I'll help you out, then.

text.ja: このディルドはそのぉ……遺跡で一人だったときの慰み道具、だったもので……年甲斐もなく恥ずかしい……っ
text.en: This... thing... was just something I used to comfort myself when I was alone in the ruins. It's embarrassing, but I'm still a woman, after all...

text.ja: 生殖行為にも、興味はあるよぉ。私だって女で……性欲もまだ衰えてないんだから。だからぁ、いいよ……
text.en: I'm still interested in sex, of course. I'm a woman, and I still have desires. So, yes... that's okay with me.

text.ja: 異性と交わるなんていつぶりかぁっ、んああっ、こんなに気持ちよかったなんて、すっかり忘れてたよぉ！
text.en: I'd forgotten how good it feels to be with someone... it's been so long.
